description: Story checkpoints for the Mesen2-OOS Cheats & Warps panel and mesen2_client.py checkpoint. Order follows Docs/Planning/story_canon_beat_sheet.md. See Data/debug/README.md.
apply: Resolve the 'after' chain (oldest first) and apply every write in order to WRAM $7EF000-$7EF4FF. 'value' stores the byte, 'set_bits' ORs, 'clear_bits' ANDs out. Then copy $7EF000-$7EF4FF to the active SRAM slot (main + mirror, new inverse checksum at +$4FE); other slots are untouched. Then warp to 'location' (an entrance id, or an overworld area from warps.json).
evidence_legend: Each write cites file:line (with the symbol for Core/sram.asm) or a beat-sheet row. Line numbers were read on 2026-09-26 from the working tree. inferred=true: the docs are silent or disagree, and the value is a best guess; 'why' says what it rests on.

checkpoints.label: New file: Link's house before the plea
checkpoints.notes: Warping into room $104 with GameState 0 and OOSPROG2 bit $10 clear re-runs the bed block (Docs/Planning/Plans/intro_plan_2026-09-24.md:33); with IntroState 0 the arrival gate then starts the new-game scenes (Core/Cutscene/opening.asm:84-96). On b17 (arrival + experiment flags on) the scene waits for text input; Start skips it (Core/Cutscene/experiment.asm:18).

checkpoints.label: Impa following: Wayward Village (hole here, Farore one screen west)
checkpoints.notes: Lands at the exit of cave room $00FE, next to the village hole (entrance $80, Docs/Planning/Plans/impa_follower_hints_2026-09-25.md:23); Impa's hint $1C8 may open (module $0E). This is also the Farore-meeting state (beat 6): Farore's sprite stands on area $2A, one screen west (impa_follower_hints_2026-09-25.md:24). $2A has no exit-table room, and the beat sheet's special area $80 cannot be warp-loaded (Data/debug/README.md, Limits). Kydrog and Farore spawn while KydrogFaroreRemoved = 0 (Sprites/Bosses/kydrog.asm:95).

checkpoints.label: Abyss arrival after Kydrog's ambush
checkpoints.notes: Same exit the banish uses (Kydrog_WarpPlayerAway loads room $20's exit, Sprites/Bosses/kydrog.asm:166). With GameState 2 and OOSPROG < 2 a continue also starts in the Abyss (Overworld/overworld.asm:105-109). The storm bit stays set in the Abyss and ends back on Kalyxo (Overworld/storm.asm:10-18); b17 and older cleared it at the Farore beat instead. The first Eon Owl (EonOwlFlags bit 0) is not placed yet.
